dog.description_text:
This precious little girl came to ARF all the way from California and is ready to find a family to call her own. With her adorable face, petite size, and sweet personality, Lady is pretty hard to resist!

She may be a little lady, but she has a whole lot of charm. Lady is ready to find someone who will shower her with love and give her the forever home she deserves.
dog.name: Lady
